thinking: Reflected parameters based on council analysis. Key insights: (1) Original params worked well (OA 0.832), so make SMALL adjustments only. (2) Gemini/Opus failed by over-relaxing thresholds (35) and widening angles too much (±[5,11]). (3) GPT/Group crashed due to angle range [5,12] being too wide, causing computational explosion. CHANGES FROM ORIGINAL: (a) dilation_iterations 1→2: slight increase to help sparse regions connect, but keep 3x3 kernel to avoid over-connecting. (b) hough_threshold_oblique 50→45: modest 10% reduction (not 30% like LLMs did). (c) minLineLength_oblique 100→85: slight 15% reduction (not 30-40% like LLMs). (d) maxLineGap_oblique 40→50: modest 25% increase (not 75-100% like LLMs). (e) angle_range ±[6,9]→±[5,10]: slightly wider but still SAFE from horizontal (0°). These conservative adjustments aim to improve sparse-region recall without introducing the false positives and computational issues that plagued the LLM solutions.
